cohort: Infants with a gestational age of more than 35 weeks born at Naresuan University Hospital between January 2019 and December 2020 were enrolled in the study.
finding: Vaginal delivery and neonatal sepsis were identified as significant risk factors for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.
mod_finding: Compared to vaginal delivery, cesarean section reduced the risk of neonatal hyperbilirubinemia by 32%.
